parameters.name: bhard
parameters.description: Hard blocks quota limit. This argument supports human readable sizes.

parameters.name: bsoft
parameters.description: Soft blocks quota limit. This argument supports human readable sizes.

parameters.name: mountpoint
parameters.description: The mount point on which to apply the quotas.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the user, group or project to apply the quota to, if other than default.

parameters.name: rtbhard
parameters.description: Hard realtime blocks quota limit. This argument supports human readable sizes.

parameters.name: rtbsoft
parameters.description: Soft realtime blocks quota limit. This argument supports human readable sizes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to apply the limits or remove them. When removing limit, they are set to 0, and not quite removed. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

examples:
- name: Set default project soft and hard limit on /opt of 1g
  community.general.xfs_quota:
    type: project
    mountpoint: /opt
    bsoft: 1g
    bhard: 1g
    state: present

- name: Remove the default limits on /opt
  community.general.xfs_quota:
    type: project
    mountpoint: /opt
    state: absent

- name: Set default soft user inode limits on /home of 1024 inodes and hard of 2048
  community.general.xfs_quota:
    type: user
    mountpoint: /home
    isoft: 1024
    ihard: 2048

return_values.name: bhard
return_values.description: The current bhard setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1024

return_values.name: bsoft
return_values.description: The current bsoft setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1024

return_values.name: ihard
return_values.description: The current ihard setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 100

return_values.name: isoft
return_values.description: The current isoft setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 100

return_values.name: rtbhard
return_values.description: The current rtbhard setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1024

return_values.name: rtbsoft
return_values.description: The current rtbsoft setting in bytes. Returned: always Sample: 1024
